turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to buy one piece of baking kit this month and I've narrowed it down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A digital kitchen scale, so I can stop guessing with cups and weigh everything properly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe a stand mixer instead, it's expensive but would save my arms on bread and meringue.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a cast iron pot for crusty bread, which people online swear by.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or just a good set of heavy baking trays, because mine warp in the oven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The scale is cheap and will improve almost everything you bake straight away. The stand mixer is a joy, but it's a big spend for one month. The pot and the trays are great upgrades if you already know you'll bake lots of bread or cookies.
